examples: Keep working through a rate limit without stopping to log in to another account.
After switching accounts, confirm and reset all sessions still running on the previous account.
A session that hit its weekly limit overnight is restarted on another account and keeps working, with no one at the keyboard.
how_to: Turn on auto-switch. When the account a session uses hits its limit, new sessions move to another signed-in account, and a running session frozen on the limit is restarted on that account and sent continue.
On the Providers page, check the confirmation beside the running sessions, then press reset all to restart those sessions on the active account.
name: Account auto-switch
summary: automatically switch to another signed-in account when the one you're using hits a rate limit.
where: The switch icon beside PROVIDER LEDGER on the home screen and in the drawer's PROVIDERS panel.
The auto-switch accounts section on the Providers page.
